blocks.text: Yeh chapter algorithms aur masle hal karne ka poora introduction deta hai. Shuru mein computational problems ki tareef ki gayi aur unhein solvable ya unsolvable, aur tractable ya intractable mein baanta gaya. Generate and test jaise aham algorithmic tareeqe samjhaye gaye, aur search, sorting, optimization aur decision jaisi maslon ki qismein bhi. Phir design techniques dekhi gayin: greedy algorithms, divide and conquer, dynamic programming aur backtracking. Chapter mein aam istemal hone wale algorithms, efficiency, aur Big O notation ke saath complexity analysis bhi shamil hai. Yeh batata hai ke maslon ko achhi tarah hal karne aur practically istemal karne ke liye algorithmic soch kitni ahem hai, aur yeh ke har masle ki khaas zaroorat ke mutabiq trade-offs (ek faide ke badle doosra nuqsan, jaise waqt vs memory) ko parakh kar balance (tawazun) karna zaroori hai.
